hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && uv run ruff check --fix --unsafe-fixes "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && uv run isort "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == tests/*.py ]] && python scripts/check_mock_spec.py "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
